summary.text: Rick Niemeyer is a Republican who has represented Indiana Senate District 6, which covers Benton and Newton counties and portions of Lake and Jasper counties, since 2014, after serving in the Indiana House of Representatives from 2012 to 2014.
He chairs the Environmental Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to his Indiana Senate Republican biography, Niemeyer attended Indiana State University and owns and operates Lowell Livestock Auction and Niemeyer Auction Service.
He is a former West Creek Township trustee and assessor and a former Lake County councilman, and chaired the Lake County Solid Waste Board.
He is also the ranking member of the Local Government Committee and a member of the Tax and Fiscal Policy Committee.
The page lists him as president of Lake County Community Services and married to Connie.
